1001316.text: TG Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on acquiring, developing and commercializing treatments for B-cell diseases. The company markets BRIUMVI (ublituximab-xiiy), an FDA-approved monoclonal antibody for relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, in the U.S. and internationally through a partnership with Neuraxpharm.

1013237.text: FactSet is a global financial digital platform providing data, analytics, and AI-powered technologies to investment professionals. It operates across Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific regions with offices in multiple countries. The company serves institutional asset managers, wealth managers, hedge funds, and other investment professionals.

1015922.text: Check Point Software Technologies develops information and network security solutions for enterprises. The company competes in global cybersecurity markets against companies including Cisco, Fortinet, and Palo Alto Networks.

1032975.text: Logitech designs and sells computer peripherals and software-enabled hardware for work, gaming, and video collaboration. Headquartered in Switzerland, it operates globally, selling through retailers, distributors, and direct channels to businesses and consumers.

1035267.text: ISRG develops and markets robotic-assisted surgical systems, including da Vinci platforms, and diagnostic systems. The company provides instruments, software, and support services to hospitals and healthcare systems worldwide.

1035983.text: Comfort Systems USA provides mechanical and electrical contracting services through 50 operating units in 142 US cities. Its mechanical division offers HVAC, plumbing and fire protection, while its electrical division handles system installation and servicing. The company serves commercial, industrial and institutional customers in manufacturing, healthcare, education and government sectors.

1037646.text: Mettler-Toledo is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services for research, quality control, and manufacturing. Products include laboratory balances, pipettes, analytical instruments, and process analytics solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, food, and chemical industries. It operates in more than 140 countries.

1038074.text: Silicon Labs designs and manufactures analog-intensive, mixed-signal semiconductors for the Internet of Things (IoT). Its wireless microcontrollers and integrated circuits support Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Zigbee, and other wireless protocols. The company serves electronics manufacturers and developers globally through direct sales and distributors.

104169.text: Walmart is an omnichannel retailer operating over 10,900 stores across 19 countries and eCommerce platforms. It serves approximately 280 million weekly customers through both physical retail and online channels, offering merchandise and services at everyday low prices.

105016.text: Watsco is the largest HVAC/R distributor in North America, distributing air conditioning, heating, refrigeration equipment, and related supplies. Operating 695 locations across 43 U.S. states, Canada, Mexico, and Puerto Rico, Watsco serves over 130,000 active contractors in the replacement and new construction markets.

105634.text: EMCOR is a specialty contractor providing electrical and mechanical construction, building, and industrial services through approximately 100 operating subsidiaries, primarily serving commercial, manufacturing, healthcare and government customers in the United States.

1056696.text: Manhattan Associates develops cloud-based supply chain and omnichannel commerce software solutions for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, and logistics providers. Headquartered in Atlanta, the company delivers Manhattan Active applications as subscription-based SaaS, enabling customers to manage supply chain execution, inventory, and omnichannel operations globally.

1058090.text: Chipotle owns and operates restaurants serving burritos, bowls, quesadillas, tacos and salads with responsibly sourced ingredients. As of December 31, 2025, the company operated 3,938 U.S. restaurants and 104 international locations.

1058290.text: Cognizant is a professional services company providing consulting, application development, systems integration, infrastructure, security, and automation services to clients in healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, aerospace, communications, media, and technology industries.

1059556.text: Moody's is an integrated risk assessment firm providing data, analytics, credit ratings and research through two segments serving financial services, corporate, banking and insurance customers. With approximately 16,000 employees across more than 40 countries, Moody's helps customers navigate global risk and financial complexity.

1075531.text: Booking operates five online travel and restaurant reservation brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, and OpenTable. The company facilitates online bookings for accommodations, flights, attractions and restaurants for consumers globally. It serves travelers, travel service providers, restaurants and businesses through merchant, agency and advertising revenue models.

1082554.text: United Therapeutics develops therapies for serious diseases, particularly pulmonary arterial hypertension. The company markets FDA-approved products including treprostinil formulations and tadalafil in the United States and select international markets. Products are sold through specialty pharmaceutical distributors.

1089063.text: Dick's Sporting Goods is a sports retailer offering equipment, apparel, footwear and accessories through DICK'S Sporting Goods, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands and Foot Locker banners. The company operates across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. It serves athletes and sneaker enthusiasts through physical stores and the GameChanger digital platform.

1090727.text: UPS is a global package delivery and logistics provider offering transportation, delivery, distribution, contract logistics, ocean freight, airfreight, customs brokerage and insurance. The company serves over 200 countries and territories, with a focus on healthcare, business-to-business, small and medium-sized businesses, and international markets.

1090872.text: Agilent develops and sells instruments, software, services, and consumables for laboratory workflows in life sciences, diagnostics, and applied markets. The company operates globally with R&D and manufacturing in the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. It serves pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, diagnostic, clinical, and academic customers.

109198.text: TJX is the leading off-price apparel and home fashions retailer with over 5,200 stores. It operates TJ Maxx, Marshalls, and HomeGoods in the U.S., plus TK Maxx in Europe and Australia, serving consumers.

1093557.text: Dexcom designs and commercializes continuous glucose monitoring systems for diabetes and metabolic health management by patients, caregivers, and clinicians worldwide. Its CGM systems enable real-time glucose monitoring with remote monitoring and connectivity to wearable devices such as Apple Watch.

109563.text: Applied Industrial Technologies is a value-added distributor and technical solutions provider of industrial motion, fluid power, flow control and automation products. The company operates 580 facilities primarily in North America, with additional presence in Australia, New Zealand and Singapore. It serves industrial manufacturers and processors through MRO, OEM and system installation applications.

1097149.text: Align Technology designs and manufactures Invisalign clear aligners, iTero intraoral scanners, and exocad CAD/CAM software for digital dentistry. It sells primarily through dedicated sales force to orthodontists, general dentists, dental laboratories, and dental support organizations globally.

1099800.text: Edwards Lifesciences develops and markets medical devices for structural heart disease treatment, including transcatheter and surgical valve replacement and repair systems. It operates globally, with commercialization in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company serves cardiac surgeons and interventional cardiologists.

1116132.text: Tapestry operates Coach and kate spade new york, global accessories and lifestyle brands selling handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, and footwear. It serves consumers through direct-to-consumer stores, e-commerce, and wholesale channels across North America, Europe, Asia, and other regions.

1121788.text: Garmin designs and manufactures GPS-enabled products and services for navigation, communications, and fitness tracking. It serves five primary markets: fitness, outdoor, aviation, marine, and automotive. The company sells to consumers worldwide and commercial customers including aircraft operators and fleet owners.

1140859.text: Cencora is a global pharmaceutical sourcing and distribution company serving healthcare providers in the United States and select global markets. It distributes brand-name, specialty and generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter products and home healthcare supplies, plus provides data analytics, consulting and pharmacy automation services. Customers include hospitals, pharmacies, clinics and veterinarians.

1141391.text: Mastercard operates a global payments network enabling electronic transactions for consumers, merchants, and financial institutions through its Mastercard, Maestro, and Cirrus brands. It provides payment products, processing, security, and analytics services supporting consumer, commercial, and digital payments.

1145197.text: Insulet develops, manufactures, and sells continuous insulin delivery systems, primarily the Omnipod platform for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. The company operates in the United States and internationally. It sells through wholesalers, healthcare organizations, and directly to consumers, with coverage through commercial insurance and government healthcare programs.

1156039.text: Elevance Health is a leading U.S. health insurer serving approximately 45.2 million members through managed care plans and health services. Operating in all 50 states and Puerto Rico under brands including Anthem Blue Cross and Wellpoint, the company provides medical, pharmacy and behavioral health coverage. It serves individuals, employer groups, and government program members.

1158114.text: Applied Optoelectronics is a vertically integrated provider of fiber-optic networking and optical communications products for internet data centers, cable television, telecommunications, and fiber-to-the-home markets. The company designs and manufactures components through turn-key equipment with laser chip manufacturing in Sugar Land, Texas, serving hyperscale data center operators, cable providers, and telecommunications equipment manufacturers globally.

1179929.text: Molina Healthcare provides managed healthcare services to approximately 5.5 million members across 21 states under Medicaid, Medicare, and state marketplace programs. It serves low-income Americans and government-sponsored health plan beneficiaries.

1237831.text: Globus Medical develops and commercializes medical devices for treating musculoskeletal disorders, including spine surgery solutions and spinal cord stimulation systems. It operates in 65 countries worldwide and serves hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and surgeons.

1262039.text: FTNT is a cybersecurity leader offering integrated networking and security solutions. Its platform includes firewalls, SASE, and security operations tools. The company serves enterprises in financial services, retail, healthcare, and government in over 100 countries.

1262823.text: Westlake is a vertically integrated global manufacturer with two segments: Housing and Infrastructure Products (residential siding, trim, windows, PVC pipe and compounds) and Performance and Essential Materials. The company serves residential construction, commercial, industrial and other markets worldwide.

1282637.text: NewMarket is a holding company whose subsidiaries include Afton (a major lubricant and fuel additives manufacturer with operations in North America, Europe, Asia, Africa and South America), AMPAC (specialty materials for solid rocket motors) and Calca (hydrazine products). AMPAC and Calca serve aerospace and defense markets in the United States.

1288469.text: MaxLinear is a fabless semiconductor company providing communications systems-on-chip for broadband, mobile and wireline infrastructure, data center, and industrial applications. It serves electronics distributors, OEMs, and ODMs serving data centers, broadband networks, and industrial markets.

1289419.text: Morningstar is a global provider of independent investment insights and data. It offers investment analysis tools, research, credit ratings, and investment management services with approximately $378 billion in assets under management. The company serves asset managers, wealth managers, advisors, and investors globally through desktop and web-based platforms.

1289460.text: Texas Roadhouse operates three casual dining concepts: Texas Roadhouse offering steaks and seafood, Bubba's 33 featuring burgers and pizza, and Jaggers fast-casual restaurants. It operates 714 company-owned and 102 franchised locations across 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries, serving consumers seeking affordable casual dining.

1300514.text: Sands owns and operates integrated resort properties featuring premium accommodations, gaming, entertainment, retail, and convention facilities. It operates in Macao and Singapore, serving leisure and business tourists.

1326801.text: Meta develops social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Messenger) and virtual reality products (Meta Quest, Ray-Ban Meta glasses). It generates revenue primarily through advertising on its apps to reach consumers, and through sales of consumer hardware and content.

1393052.text: Veeva provides cloud software, data, and business consulting solutions for the global life sciences industry, helping pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies develop and commercialize products more efficiently.

1397187.text: Lululemon designs, distributes, and retails technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories. It operates in 30 countries through an omni-channel model with physical retail locations and e-commerce. The company serves individual customers and wholesale partners including fitness studios, athletic organizations, and corporate entities.

1403161.text: Visa provides payment transaction processing services including authorization, clearing and settlement across more than 200 countries and territories, serving nearly 14,500 financial institutions, merchants, consumers, and government entities.

1403568.text: Ulta is a specialty beauty retailer offering cosmetics, fragrance, skincare, wellness products, haircare, and salon services through stores and digital platforms. It operates in the U.S., U.K., Ireland, Mexico, and the Middle East, serving beauty enthusiasts.

1441816.text: MongoDB is a developer data platform company offering a modern, document-based database designed for unstructured data, along with integrated services for search, analytics, and data processing. It serves development teams and organizations building applications across diverse industries and use cases.

1467373.text: ACN is a global professional services company. It helps enterprises build digital capabilities through strategy, consulting, technology, and operations services. The company operates across Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific serving major enterprises worldwide.

1486159.text: Chord Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company operating primarily in the Williston Basin. It produces crude oil, natural gas, and NGL from approximately 1.3 million net leasehold acres with average daily production of 276,620 net Boepd.

1489393.text: LYB is a global chemical company that converts hydrocarbon feedstocks into plastic resins and other chemicals, and develops and licenses polyolefin technologies. Its products serve manufacturers of food packaging, automotive components, and coatings. The company operates globally with no single customer accounting for 10% or more of revenues.

1511737.text: Ubiquiti develops and sells networking equipment and software platforms for high-capacity internet access and unified network management, distributing products globally through over 100 distributors to service providers, enterprises and customers across more than 200 countries and territories.

1521332.text: Aptiv is a global industrial technology company developing advanced automotive and industrial technology solutions across three segments: software and sensors, interconnect systems, and power distribution. The company operates 139 manufacturing facilities across 50 countries. It serves the 25 largest automotive OEMs worldwide, as well as aerospace, defense, and telecom companies.

1531152.text: BJ's Wholesale Club is a membership warehouse operator offering groceries, general merchandise, gasoline, and ancillary services. Operating 263 clubs and 199 gas stations across 21 U.S. states as of fiscal 2025, primarily in the eastern United States, BJ's serves over 8 million individual and business members.

1555280.text: Zoetis is a global leader in animal health, discovering and commercializing medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, and genetic tests. Products serve eight species across companion animals (dogs, cats, horses) and livestock, sold through veterinarians and distributors worldwide. Customers include veterinarians, pet owners, and livestock producers.

1565025.text: Ambev manufactures and distributes beverages in Brazil and other countries. Products are packaged in aluminum cans and PET bottles and include ingredients such as malt, hops, and sugar. The company sells to clients throughout the region.

1576280.text: Guardant Health provides precision oncology diagnostics through blood and tissue tests for cancer screening, recurrence monitoring, and treatment selection across all stages of care. The company also collaborates with biopharmaceutical companies for clinical research and drug development.

1579241.text: Allegion develops and markets security and access control products including door controls, electronic locks, access control systems and related software. The company operates globally across North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. It serves commercial, institutional and residential customers including education, healthcare, government, hospitality and retail sectors.

1583708.text: SentinelOne develops and commercializes the Singularity Platform, an AI-powered cybersecurity solution for autonomous defense against cyberattacks. The platform protects endpoints, cloud workloads, and identities using distributed AI models and threat analytics. It serves organizations of all sizes globally, including large enterprises, managed security providers, and incident response partners.

1585521.text: Zoom is a collaboration platform offering workplace communication and productivity tools including meetings, chat, phone, and contact center services, integrated with AI capabilities. It serves businesses of all sizes for employee collaboration and customer engagement.

1590955.text: Paycom is a leading cloud-based HCM solution provider offering SaaS software for payroll, talent management, HR, and time and labor management. It serves approximately 39,200 business clients in the United States through its internally developed single-platform system.

1591698.text: Paylocity provides cloud-based human capital management, finance, and IT software solutions to U.S. organizations. The unified SaaS platform automates HR processes, payroll, benefits management, and employee workflows. It serves approximately 44,400 clients averaging over 150 employees each through direct sales and a referral network.

1596532.text: Arista provides networking-as-a-service solutions and platforms for data centers and AI operations. Its switches, software and services enable Cloud and AI providers, specialty providers and enterprises to reliably access and process data globally.

1601046.text: Keysight Technologies provides design and test solutions including hardware, software and services to support product development and commercialization. It serves over 100 countries across industries including communications, aerospace, defense, automotive and semiconductor. The company generated $5.4 billion in revenue in 2025, primarily from R&D applications.

1604821.text: Natera is a diagnostics company using proprietary cell-free DNA technology to develop blood-based tests in oncology, women's health and organ health. Based in Austin, Texas with facilities in California and Colorado, the company has a US direct sales force and over 100 international laboratory and distribution partners. It processed 3.5 million tests in 2025.

1622536.text: TLN is an independent power producer operating approximately 13.1 GW of U.S. generation capacity, including 2.2 GW of nuclear power. The company sells electricity, capacity and ancillary services to wholesale power markets in the Mid-Atlantic, Ohio and Montana, including AWS.

1633917.text: PayPal operates a digital payments platform connecting consumers and merchants across approximately 200 markets. It provides digital wallets (PayPal and Venmo), point-of-sale solutions, buy-now-pay-later services, and international money transfers. As of December 2025, the platform had 439 million active accounts.

1652044.text: Alphabet operates Google, a technology company providing search, video (YouTube), email, cloud infrastructure and services, and AI products. Google Cloud serves enterprise customers seeking cloud computing and AI capabilities. Google also generates advertising revenue from advertisers reaching consumers through its platforms.

1658566.text: PR is a crude petroleum and natural gas producer that sells its production to a relatively small number of customers, typical in the industry. The excerpt provides limited detail on specific operations and customer identities.

1668397.text: MEDP is a leading clinical contract research organization providing Phase I-IV clinical development services to biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device companies. It operates from facilities in Cincinnati, Belgium, Shanghai and Singapore, serving small, mid-sized and large pharmaceutical customers.

1673358.text: Yum China operates KFC, Pizza Hut, Lavazza, Huang Ji Huang, Little Sheep and Taco Bell restaurants in China. The company operates over 18,100 units across more than 2,500 cities primarily in mainland China. It serves consumers seeking quick-service and casual dining options.

1800667.text: JFrog provides a unified software supply chain platform for governance, security and delivery of software applications and AI/ML models. The platform serves enterprise software organizations and development teams. The company's customer base includes the majority of the Fortune 500 using it as a system of record for software development.

1801368.text: MP Materials is the largest producer of rare earth materials in the Western Hemisphere, with mining and processing operations at Mountain Pass, California and magnet manufacturing at Independence Facility in Texas. The company produces rare earth oxides, metals, alloys and magnets, selling primarily to customers in Japan, South Korea and Asia, as well as to automotive companies including General Motors.

1810806.text: Unity is a platform for developing and monetizing games and interactive experiences across mobile, PC, console, and extended reality. Create Solutions provide development tools and engines; Grow Solutions enable user acquisition and monetization. The platform serves creators globally across gaming and non-gaming industries.

1824920.text: IonQ is a quantum computing platform company developing quantum computers and related networking, sensing, and security products. It offers quantum-computing-as-a-service through AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud platforms, and provides professional services.

1828108.text: Aurora Innovation develops the Aurora Driver, a self-driving technology platform for autonomous vehicles. Founded in 2017, the company focuses initially on trucking, with plans to expand to passenger mobility and local goods delivery. Aurora partners with major vehicle manufacturers and logistics companies and operates in the United States.

1932393.text: GE HealthCare is a global healthcare solutions provider of medical devices, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and AI-enabled cloud and software solutions. It operates in over 160 countries through four segments: Imaging, Advanced Visualization Solutions, Patient Care Solutions, and Pharmaceutical Diagnostics. Customers include hospitals, health systems, and research institutions.

1964738.text: Solventum is a global healthcare company with three segments: MedSurg solutions (wound care, surgical supplies), Dental Solutions (orthodontics and restorative products), and Health Information Systems (healthcare software). It serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare systems.

1973266.text: TKO is a premium sports and entertainment company operating UFC, WWE, and Professional Bull Riders, along with sports marketing agency IMG and experiential hospitality business On Location. Its properties reach over 1 billion households across 210 countries. Revenue sources include media rights licensing, live events, partnerships with major brands, and consumer products.

200406.text: Johnson & Johnson researches, develops, and manufactures healthcare products through two segments: Innovative Medicine (pharmaceuticals for oncology, immunology, and other therapeutic areas) and MedTech (medical devices for cardiovascular, orthopedic, surgical, and vision care). Products are distributed to healthcare professionals, hospitals, and retailers worldwide.

2035989.text: Amrize is a North American building solutions company offering cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, roofing systems, and wall solutions. The company operates more than 1,000 sites across the United States, Canada, Colombia, Switzerland, and Jamaica, serving more than 23,000 customers in infrastructure, commercial, and residential construction.

2099039.text: Wise Group provides cross-border payment and money transfer services through Wise Account (individuals), Wise Business (SMBs), and Wise Platform (banks and institutions). Headquartered in London, the company operates globally with offices spanning North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. It served 18.9 million customers in fiscal 2026.

21665.text: Colgate-Palmolive manufactures and sells oral care products like toothpaste and mouthwash, personal care items including soaps and deodorants, and home care products such as dishwashing liquids and cleaners. Through Hill's Pet Nutrition, it markets specialty pet foods. The company sells to retailers, wholesalers, distributors and veterinarians in over 200 countries.

27419.text: Target is a retail company offering fashionable, differentiated merchandise and everyday essentials at discounted prices through stores and digital channels. The company sells general merchandise, groceries and owned brand products, with approximately half of merchandise sourced from outside the United States.

277135.text: Grainger is a distributor of maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) products and services operating in North America, Japan and recently exited the UK. It serves over 4.6 million customers ranging from small businesses to large corporations and government entities through high-touch solutions and online platforms like Zoro and MonotaRO.

277948.text: CSX is a railroad transportation company based in Jacksonville, Florida operating a 20,000 route-mile network across 26 eastern U.S. states and Canadian provinces. It provides freight transportation services including rail, intermodal and coal transport. CSX serves manufacturers, automotive companies, retailers, farmers, energy producers and other businesses.

29644.text: Donaldson is a global filtration company providing air, fuel, hydraulic, and industrial filtration products for mobile, industrial, and life sciences applications. It operates across six continents with manufacturing and distribution centers, serving OEMs and distributors in construction, mining, agriculture, transportation, aerospace, and data center industries.

313616.text: DHR is a science and technology company with three segments: Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Diagnostics. It provides equipment, consumables, and services to pharmaceutical companies, research institutions, and manufacturers globally across approximately 50 countries.

313927.text: Church & Dwight develops and markets consumer household and personal care products under brands including ARM & HAMMER and OXICLEAN, plus specialty products for animal and food production. The company operates in the United States and internationally across Canada, Europe, Australia, and Japan, selling through supermarkets, mass merchandisers, and drugstores.

31791.text: RVTY provides health science solutions including reagents, instruments, assay platforms and software across Life Sciences and Diagnostics segments. The company operates in more than 160 countries, serving pharmaceutical, biotech, research organizations, hospitals and clinicians.

318154.text: Amgen discovers, develops, manufactures and delivers innovative medicines for diseases with high unmet medical need. The company is one of the world's leading independent biotechnology companies. Its medicines address cardiovascular, rare disease and oncology indications.

319201.text: KLA supplies process control equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing and electronic device production. It serves semiconductor and electronic device manufacturers globally through three segments: Semiconductor Process Control, Specialty Semiconductor Process, and PCB and Component Inspection.

320187.text: Nike designs and markets athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories under Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands. It sells through wholesale accounts and Nike Direct operations including retail stores and digital platforms across North America, Europe, Middle East & Africa, Greater China, and Asia Pacific & Latin America.

320193.text: Apple designs and manufactures smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, along with digital services including the App Store, Apple Music, and Apple Pay. It operates globally across the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. Apple serves consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, education, enterprise, and government customers.

353278.text: NVO is a global healthcare company and world leader in obesity and diabetes care. It manufactures and markets GLP-1 receptor agonists, insulins, and rare disease pharmaceuticals in approximately 170 countries.

354950.text: Home Depot is the world's largest home improvement retailer, offering home improvement products, building materials and installation services. It operates 2,359 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, serving homeowners and professional contractors.

40533.text: General Dynamics is an aerospace and defense company providing business jets through Gulfstream, ship construction and repair, combat systems and technology solutions. The company operates in business aviation and defense markets with facilities on four continents including Savannah, Georgia.

4127.text: Skyworks Solutions develops and manufactures analog and mixed-signal semiconductor products for applications including aerospace, automotive, broadband, cellular, defense, industrial and smartphones. The company operates worldwide with facilities in Asia, Europe and North America. It serves OEMs and smartphone providers in wireless connectivity markets.

42888.text: Graco manufactures equipment and systems for managing and applying fluids and coatings in industrial and commercial applications. The company operates globally with manufacturing in the United States and multiple international locations. It serves manufacturing, processing, construction and maintenance industries through three business segments.

47111.text: Hershey is a global confectionery leader producing chocolate, non-chocolate confectionery, and salty snacks under brands like Hershey's and Reese's. The company operates in approximately 65 countries with manufacturing in North America, Mexico, Brazil, India, and Malaysia. Customers include wholesalers, grocery stores, mass merchandisers, and vending companies.

49071.text: Humana provides health insurance and healthcare services, primarily through federal government contracts for Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries. It offers HMO, PPO, and POS plans, pharmacy services, and clinical programs across the United States. The company served approximately 15 million medical benefit plan members as of December 2025.

50863.text: Intel designs and manufactures semiconductor products (CPUs and related solutions) for computing devices and services. It supplies OEMs, ODMs, and other manufacturers globally, with products serving consumers, enterprises, governments, and educational organizations. Intel also offers foundry services to external customers.

59527.text: Lincoln Electric is a global industrial machinery leader making arc welding equipment, cutting systems, wire feeders, and automation solutions. With operations in 20 countries, it serves manufacturers, fabricators, and integrators through distributors and direct sales.

723254.text: Cintas provides uniforms, facility services, mats, restroom supplies, first aid and safety products, and workplace water services to businesses. The company operates primarily in the United States, Canada, and Latin America, serving over one million businesses of all types and sizes.

723531.text: Paychex is an HCM company providing comprehensive technology and advisory solutions in HR, payroll processing, employee benefits, and insurance. It serves approximately 840,000 customers in the U.S. and parts of Europe, about 800,000 of which are payroll clients. Over 60% of revenue comes from solutions beyond payroll processing.

730272.text: Repligen develops and commercializes bioprocessing technologies and systems for biological drug manufacturing. The company operates manufacturing sites across the United States and in seven countries outside the U.S. It serves biopharmaceutical companies, contract manufacturers, and other life science companies.

731766.text: UnitedHealth Group provides health care and well-being services through Optum (health services, data analytics and pharmacy) and UnitedHealthcare (health benefits). It serves patients, consumers, employers, care providers and government entities.

737758.text: Toro designs, manufactures, and sells professional turf maintenance equipment, irrigation systems, landscaping equipment, snow and ice management products, and residential yard equipment. The company markets products worldwide through distributors, dealers, retailers, and equipment rental centers. It serves professional users including golf courses, sports fields, landscape contractors, and homeowners.

745732.text: Ross Stores operates two off-price retail apparel and home fashion brands: Ross Dress for Less and dd's DISCOUNTS. With 1,904 Ross locations across 44 states and territories and 363 dd's DISCOUNTS stores across 22 states, the company serves value-driven customers through discounted brand name merchandise.

749098.text: MGA is based in Aurora, Ontario, Canada and operates in the motor vehicle parts and accessories industry. The excerpt provided contains only filing cover pages without detailed business description.

77360.text: Pentair is a water solutions company with three operating segments: Flow (pump and fluid treatment products), Water Solutions (residential and commercial water products), and Pool (pool equipment). The company serves global residential, commercial and industrial markets through wholesalers, retailers, end users and original equipment manufacturers.

779152.text: Jack Henry & Associates provides financial technology solutions including core data processing systems and complementary services to community and regional banks and credit unions. It serves over 7,200 financial institutions with on-premise and cloud solutions.

789019.text: Microsoft develops software, cloud services (Azure, Microsoft 365), AI products, gaming consoles, and devices. It provides productivity and collaboration solutions, cloud infrastructure, and gaming services for individuals, businesses, and enterprises.

790051.text: Carlisle supplies building envelope products including roofing membranes and weatherproofing solutions through its Carlisle Construction Materials and Carlisle Weatherproofing Technologies segments. The company manufactures in the United States and Europe. It serves commercial construction and remodeling customers seeking energy-efficient building solutions.

796343.text: Adobe provides creative software solutions and platforms for content creation, design, and marketing powered by AI. The company serves business professionals, consumers, creative professionals and marketing professionals globally. Adobe's product portfolio spans document productivity, creative applications, and enterprise marketing solutions including its Experience Platform.

79879.text: PPG manufactures and distributes paints, coatings, and specialty products for industrial, automotive, aerospace, marine, and consumer applications. It operates in more than 50 countries, serving original equipment manufacturers, contractors, and consumers.

804328.text: QCOM develops and supplies integrated circuit platforms and licenses wireless technology intellectual property for mobile, automotive, and IoT applications. It serves device manufacturers globally.

815556.text: Fastenal sells industrial and construction supplies through 1,595 locations across 25 countries supported by 15 distribution centers. It serves business customers through physical sites and technologies including vending devices and managed inventory programs. The company offers nine major product lines with focus on fasteners and industrial supplies.

820313.text: Amphenol designs, manufactures and markets electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and specialty cable. The company operates three business segments globally serving Communications Solutions, Harsh Environment Solutions and Interconnect and Sensor Systems markets.

827054.text: Microchip develops, manufactures and sells embedded control semiconductor solutions for a wide variety of applications, selling primarily to distributors and direct customers worldwide.

831641.text: Tetra Tech is a global consulting and engineering services company specializing in water, environment and sustainable infrastructure solutions. The company operates through two segments serving U.S. government clients (federal, state and local), international development agencies and commercial clients across more than 100 countries.

84839.text: Rollins is a global pest and wildlife control services company with over 800 locations in approximately 70 countries. It serves more than two million residential and commercial customers through brands including Orkin and Clark Pest Control.

851205.text: Deckers Outdoor designs, markets, and distributes footwear, apparel, and accessories under three core brands: HOKA, UGG, and Teva. The company operates globally through wholesale distribution to retailers and independent distributors, and direct-to-consumer channels including e-commerce and 203 company-owned retail stores as of March 2026.

855658.text: Lattice Semiconductor develops low-power programmable logic devices and FPGAs for edge-to-cloud applications as a fabless provider. The company serves global markets in communications and computing, industrial and automotive, and consumer sectors, with customers building data centers, 5G infrastructure, IoT devices, and automotive systems.

865752.text: Monster Beverage develops, markets and distributes energy drinks, craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers through four operating segments. Based in Corona, California, the company sells primarily to bottlers, distributors, and retail chains in the U.S. and internationally.

866291.text: Allegro Microsystems designs and manufactures sensor integrated circuits and power management ICs for automotive, industrial, and data center applications. Its magnetic sensor and power IC portfolio enables motion control, sensing, and power management. The company serves global automotive OEMs and suppliers, data center operators, and industrial robotics manufacturers.

866787.text: AutoZone is a leading retailer of automotive replacement parts and accessories across the Americas. As of August 2025, it operated 6,627 stores in the US, 883 in Mexico, and 147 in Brazil. It serves retail customers and provides commercial parts delivery and credit to repair garages, dealers, service stations, and fleet owners.

8670.text: ADP is a global leader in Human Capital Management solutions serving over 1.1 million clients across 140+ countries. The company provides payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, HR outsourcing and workforce management solutions. ADP serves businesses ranging from small enterprises to Fortune 500 companies.

872589.text: Regeneron is a fully integrated biotechnology company that invents, develops, manufactures and commercializes medicines for patients with serious diseases including eye conditions, cancer, and inflammatory disorders. The company works with collaborators and licensees on product development and commercialization.

874716.text: IDEXX develops, manufactures and distributes diagnostic products and provides laboratory services for companion animal and livestock veterinarians, biomedical researchers, and water testing customers across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

875320.text: VRTX is a global biotechnology company with marketed medicines for cystic fibrosis, sickle cell disease, and beta thalassemia. It sells medicines through specialty distributors and pharmacies globally.

879169.text: Incyte is a global biopharmaceutical company developing therapies in hematology, oncology, and inflammation. Approved products include JAKAFI for myelofibrosis and graft-versus-host disease, ICLUSIG for chronic myeloid leukemia, and MONJUVI for lymphoma. The company operates globally with headquarters in the United States, Switzerland, Japan, and Canada.

88205.text: SPX Technologies offers HVAC solutions including cooling, heating, and ventilation products, as well as detection and measurement equipment for infrastructure inspection and maintenance. The company serves industrial, institutional, and commercial customers, including utilities, telecommunications providers, and government agencies.

882184.text: D.R. Horton is the largest homebuilder in the United States, constructing and selling homes across 126 markets in 36 states. The company also provides mortgage financing and title services to homebuyers.

88941.text: SMTC designs and manufactures high-performance semiconductors for data center networking, IoT connectivity, and cellular infrastructure. Its products serve original equipment manufacturers, IoT device makers, and enterprises across infrastructure, consumer and industrial markets globally.

896878.text: Intuit is a global financial technology platform serving approximately 93 million consumers, small and mid-market businesses, and accountants. The company provides tax, accounting, financial management and marketing solutions through products including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp.

898173.text: O'Reilly Automotive is a specialty retailer of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies and equipment. It operates 6,447 stores in the United States and Puerto Rico, plus locations in Mexico and Canada. The company serves both do-it-yourself customers and professional service providers.

909832.text: Costco operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites selling nationally-branded and private-label products. It operates 914 warehouses in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the UK, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland and New Zealand. Members purchase foods, non-foods and fresh foods.

91142.text: A. O. Smith manufactures and markets residential and commercial water heaters, boilers, heat pumps, tanks and water treatment products through two segments: North America (78% of sales) and Rest of World. The company serves residential and commercial markets through wholesale distribution, retail channels and direct-to-consumer sales.

914475.text: Neurocrine Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for neurological, psychiatric, and endocrine disorders. It markets FDA-approved products INGREZZA and CRENESSITY for tardive dyskinesia, Huntington's disease, and congenital adrenal hyperplasia, primarily in the U.S.

916365.text: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S., operating 2,602 stores in 49 states and online. It sells farm, ranch, pet, and garden products to recreational farmers, ranchers, homesteaders, and rural consumers.

920371.text: Simpson Manufacturing designs and manufactures structural solutions for wood and concrete construction, including connectors, fasteners, and lateral-force resisting systems. It serves residential and commercial construction markets across North America and Europe, as well as OEMs, component manufacturers, and national retailers.

920760.text: LEN is one of the largest U.S. homebuilders and also originates residential mortgage loans and provides title insurance. The company operates in over 20 states, primarily selling single-family and multifamily homes to first-time, move-up, active adult and luxury homebuyers.

927653.text: McKesson is a healthcare services company distributing pharmaceutical drugs and medical-surgical supplies. It operates four segments: North American Pharmaceutical (drug distribution in U.S. and Canada), Oncology & Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions, and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The company serves pharmacies, hospitals, healthcare providers, and biopharma companies.

928876.text: Tower is a specialty foundry manufacturing processed wafers based on customers' design specifications. It operates facilities in Israel, the U.S., Japan, and Italy, serving semiconductor companies and fabless companies in markets including data centers, automotive, industrial, and medical devices.

935703.text: Dollar Tree operates approximately 9,000 discount retail stores across 48 U.S. states and the District of Columbia, plus 275 stores in Canada. The company carries approximately 8,400 items including consumables and discretionary merchandise, serving consumers through stores and online platforms.

936468.text: Lockheed Martin is an aerospace and defense company operating four segments: Aeronautics (military aircraft), Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems (helicopters and defense systems), and Space. The company designs and manufactures advanced military aircraft, missiles, defense systems and related technologies. Its principal customers are U.S. Government agencies and international allies.

943819.text: ResMed is a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected medical devices for sleep and breathing health. Products include CPAP systems for sleep apnea, ventilation devices, masks, diagnostics, and cloud-based health applications software. It operates in more than 140 countries serving patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers.

94845.text: Levi Strauss is one of the world's largest apparel companies, designing and marketing jeans, casual and dress pants, activewear, tops and jackets under Levi's, Levi Strauss Signature and Beyond Yoga brands. The company sells to approximately 120 countries through direct-to-consumer channels, wholesale customers and licensees.

97476.text: Texas Instruments designs and manufactures semiconductors for electronics designers and manufacturers worldwide. Its products include analog and embedded processing semiconductors used in industrial, automotive, data center and communications applications. TI serves over 100,000 customers.
